claim_one_line: OBSERVER IS THE WRONG TYPE FOR MOST OF THESE ROWS; THE RIGHT ONE IS RELATION. The record's own no-go is that AN INVARIANT SELECTOR CANNOT PICK A POINT OF ITS OWN ORBIT -- a theorem about the object acting ON ITSELF. It says nothing whatever about a relation to a SECOND THING, and the word observer collapses that distinction, importing an agent where the mathematics asks only for a second relatum. The record already exploited the gap once and stopped there: the chirality bit is banked as an invariant of a heterogeneous pair, belonging to neither relatum and arriving with no act of selection. FOUR TYPES REPLACE 'EXTERNALLY SUPPLIED': D by design (a unit; nobody derives the metre), T external by theorem (lambda: the algebra is tracial, no continuous clock exists to give), R relational (an invariant of a pair, invariant under simultaneous symmetry, needing a partner and not an act), S selected (an orbit with no invariant selector AND no available relation). Only S needs anybody. ROW MOVES PROPOSED: the real-structure closing re-types S -> R, because the paper proves only that THE OBJECT'S OWN MIRROR cannot supply the antilinear involution -- one relatum refuted, not all -- and an antilinear involution IS a relation to a conjugate; family/VEV/filling and the colour frame become CANDIDATE R, since the standing argument kills invariant selectors only and a partner breaking the Z/3 triality orbit would decide the colour frame; the Standard-Model shaping stays S and is the worst row in the table, because it is target knowledge rather than a relation to any mathematical partner. AND A POSSIBLE OVER-COUNT, RAISED AS A QUESTION: link 54's mirror = swap x arrow is verified here on the object (its eight isometries realise 4 of the 8 sign triples, the index-2 subgroup cut out by det = s_m s_l, zero violations), so those three named bits carry ONE RELATION and only TWO are free; the genesis swap is booked in section 2 and the arrow and chirality bit in section 9, which is exactly where a relation spanning two tables would hide a double count -- NOT asserted, because section 8's chirality bit is a Fricke-kappa torsor class and may not be the manifold's mirror sign. WHAT RE-TYPING DOES NOT DO: close a row. The chirality bit is already R and still carries 'which pair is used remains supplied'. R relocates the residue from an ACT to an IDENTITY, which is progress only because an identity can be searched for and an observer cannot.
